The problem

A lending file only holds together if the application, the statements and the KYC documents agree.

Documents: Loan applications, bank statements and KYC documents.

Example checks

Check 1

Check statement figures against the application.

Check 2

Match identity details across KYC documents.

Check 3

How it works

01

Prepare the data

enterlabs reads loan applications, bank statements and KYC documents and turns them into structured data.

02

Check against agreed rules

It compares statement figures with the application and identity details across the KYC documents.

03

Review and record

A person reviews each flagged item and makes the final call. Every review is recorded.

An example screen

A loan application checked against bank statements and a KYC document. One income difference is flagged for review.
